goal_text:
# Hawking self-improvement: hold the hardening frontier

The control plane gained several load-bearing properties today. Each must stay
true, and each must be provable by a check that can actually fail.

## Obligation: the context budget authority keeps deriving the per-request ceiling
The canonical authority must keep dividing the allocation by the slot count and
must keep refusing an over-large root prompt before any inference. Proven by
/Users/scammermike/Downloads/hawking-copy/tools/haider/hcli/tests/test_context_budget.py.

## Obligation: the mutation lock stays a real mutual exclusion primitive
Two racing processes must never both acquire it. Proven by
/Users/scammermike/Downloads/hawking-copy/tools/haider/hcli/tests/test_mutation_lock_race.py.

## Obligation: report compaction does not inflate a tiny report
A 39-byte report must not become a 716-byte envelope, and repeated noise must not
balloon the digest. Proven by /Users/scammermike/Downloads/hawking-copy/tools/haider/hcli/tests/test_report_compiler.py.

## Obligation: Grok task identity stays unique and liveness stays observable
Two dispatches in the same second must not share a task directory, and a task
whose process is gone must not report as running. Proven by
/Users/scammermike/Downloads/hawking-copy/tools/haider/hcli/tests/test_grok_identity.py.
work_is_real: each obligation names the test file that proves it; the compiler derives a genuine pytest command from that text and a unit is accepted only on that command's own exit code

defects_this_harness_found_and_closed.title: a compiled verifier was not portable to the workspace it was scheduled into
defects_this_harness_found_and_closed.detail: The compiler emits `python3 -m pytest <path>`, but the test files import `tools.haider.hcli...`, so pytest needs the repository root on sys.path. Launched with a temp workspace as cwd, every verifier failed with ModuleNotFoundError -- for a reason with nothing to do with the claim being checked -- and the repair machinery dutifully retried the same broken command.
defects_this_harness_found_and_closed.fix: the self-supplement mission runs with the repository as its workspace, which is also the honest configuration for a self-improvement goal

defects_this_harness_found_and_closed.title: GoalCompiler._FILE_RE stripped the leading slash from absolute paths
defects_this_harness_found_and_closed.detail: An obligation naming /Users/.../test_x.py compiled to `pytest Users/.../test_x.py` -- a relative path that does not exist. Observed directly in the persisted dag.json during the first real run.
defects_this_harness_found_and_closed.fix: the pattern now admits an optional leading `/`

defects_this_harness_found_and_closed.title: compiled verifier units routed to cognition instead of the CPU backend
defects_this_harness_found_and_closed.detail: A unit whose acceptance IS a command was left on the default cognition backend, so the model was asked to perform it and tried to CREATE the very test file the obligation names ('create target already exists: .../test_context_budget.py'). Work nobody asked for, failing for a reason unrelated to the claim.
defects_this_harness_found_and_closed.fix: _build_workunit_dag sets preferred_backend='cpu' whenever the obligation supplied a verify command

note_on_repeat_runs: The harness refuses to run when .hcli/mission/state.json already exists, so it can never clobber durable mission state. The state left behind by this run is genuine evidence of a real mission and is deliberately not deleted.
